scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @llm-chess/server" "npm run dev --workspace @llm-chess/web"
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build --workspace @llm-chess/web && npm run db:migrate:local --workspace @llm-chess/cloudflare && npm run dev --workspace @llm-chess/cloudflare
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build --workspace @llm-chess/web && npm run db:migrate:remote --workspace @llm-chess/cloudflare && npm run deploy --workspace @llm-chess/cloudflare
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @llm-chess/web && npm run build --workspace @llm-chess/player-cli && npm run build --workspace @llm-chess/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace @llm-chess/server && npm run build --workspace @llm-chess/cloudflare
